name: Parakletus Hub Nigeria
what_they_do: Port Harcourt-based education technology and academic publishing company (founded by Evander Ikechukwu; CAC BN 1909664) building ParaLearn (offline-first school result management and CBT platform at pln.ng serving 2 schools and 300 students as of Nov 2026), SabiNote AI lesson note generator, and Parakletus Publishing.
recent_activity: 2026-11-10: Won NGN 1M (~$742) non-dilutive growth capital in the NiYA x Cascador Founders Programme (https://www.startuplist.africa/funding/parakletus-hub-nigeria-grant-1m-ngn-8a5eb1e); 2026-11: Reported 2 active K-12 schools and 300 enrolled students on ParaLearn plus 50+ Nigerian educators on SabiNote (https://www.parakletushub.com/about); 2026-10-02: Latest post on @parakletus_ng Instagram (https://instagram.com/p/DeADKgWjuCh)
investors: Cascador / Nigerian Youth Academy (NiYA) / Federal Ministry of Youth Development
marketing_titles_found: NONE (parakletushub.com/about lists Evander Ikechukwu CEO & Founder, Olajide Emmanuel CTO, and Ifunaya Udeh Product Manager; no marketing/growth/content titles)
hiring_marketing_role: NO (https://www.pln.ng/careers states 'Current openings will be posted here soon' with no open marketing/growth roles)
unique_offer: Offline-first Nigerian school result broadsheet and malpractice-flagged CBT suite (ParaLearn) paired with NERDC-aligned AI lesson note generation (SabiNote) across 36 state curricula.
pitch_hook: Parakletus Hub Nigeria won NiYA-Cascador funding on 2026-11-10 with ParaLearn live across only 2 schools (300 students), yet @parakletus_ng Instagram (190 followers) has been silent for 56 days since 2026-10-02, its pln.ng/blog says 'Coming Soon', and its 3-person leadership team has no marketing or growth lead.
